name: rocinante
description: Rocinante, a text adventure editor for DAAD that runs in the browser: imports classic DAAD and PAW games and exports to the web, ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC, Commodore 64, MSX, PC (DOS), Atari ST and Amiga
